title: Bag of bricks- Green 22
descriptionHtml:
Green — colour 22

A true mid-green and the backbone of any natural scene. Leaves, hedges, garden backgrounds — if a build has plant life in it, this is usually the bag that empties first.

Works well with: Grass 28, Dark Green 23, Jungle Green 16

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Green bricks (colour 22) for Memobrick mosaics. A true mid-green for grass, leaves and fresh outdoor scenes. Resealable bag, precision fit.
